title: Prophetic Political Polemics and Visionary Prose

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Endre Ady's journalism remains the gold standard of Hungarian visionary polemics. Writing in Nagyvárad and Budapest, he lashed out (*ostorozott*) against feudal backwardness (*megcsontosodott elmaradottság*), political complacency, and national self-delusion.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Ady's prose relies on prophetic fronting: placing the existential crisis into the thematic slot and driving the sentence to an explosive rhythmic verdict: *Itt nem reformocskák kellenek: itt a történelem ítélőszéke előtt állunk.*

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: The relentless castigation of ossified conditions...
Visionary clarity of vision and profound anxiety...
Az ország vesztébe rohan, ha nem ébred fel...
The country rushes to its doom if it does not awake...
